first.text:
Here's the comparison. I've grouped the old exercises by whether something close has taken their place or whether they've genuinely dropped out.

**Dropped, with a close cousin still in the plan**

| Old exercise | What's covering it now |
|---|---|
| Assisted Dip (Machine) | Dip negatives on bench day |
| Lunge (Dumbbell) | Split squat on squat day, Bulgarian split squat on deadlift day |
| Single Arm Row (Dumbbell) | Chest-supported dumbbell row on press day |
| Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell) | Barbell RDL on squat day |
| Hanging Leg Raise | Lying leg raise on pull-up day |
| Incline Curl (Dumbbell) | Standing dumbbell curl plus hammer curl on deadlift day |
| Push Up (standard, in the circuit) | Ring push-up in the circuit |

**Dropped with no direct replacement**

- Chest Fly (Dumbbell): the only isolated chest work you had. Chest now comes from bench, incline dumbbell bench, dip negatives and whatever the PT gives you on chest/back Tuesday.
- Straight Arm Lat Pulldown (Band): you did this on three of ten old days as a lat/pull-up accessory.
- Inverted Row
- Assisted Pull Up (Machine): the banded pull-up carries the assisted work now, with the ladder running on it.
- Hollow Hold, Arch Hold, Side Plank: the gymnastic core trio is gone. Core is now ab wheel, lying leg raise, suitcase carry and the PT's legs/core day.
- Seated Calf Raise (Machine): only the single-leg standing calf raise survives (twice a week).
- Step Up (Dumbbell): was in the old circuit.

**New in the current plan that the old one didn't have**: farmers walk, suitcase carry, chest-supported row, a daily dead hang on its own, and a strict pull-up test single at the start of squat day.

My read, for what it's worth: the ones most worth considering are chest fly (if you feel chest is under-dosed on non-PT days), one of the holds (hollow or side plank, cheap to superset with the ab wheel), and the straight-arm pulldown if you miss it as a pull-up warm-up. The rest look like deliberate consolidation rather than losses.

Tell me which, if any, you want back and I'll work out where they'd fit without pushing a session over time, then show you exactly what would change before anything's recorded.
